app.name: TidyDash
app.summary: For people who want a personal at-a-glance space for small bits of info. They juggle notes, counts, to-dos and links across apps and paper. TidyDash lets them create a dashboard, add note, counter, checklist and link-list widgets, arrange and resize them, with every change saved automatically.
app.audience: Individuals who want a personal space for notes, numbers, tasks and links

roles.name: Visitor
roles.description: Someone discovering personal dashboards; views the landing page and can sign up or sign in.

roles.name: Member
roles.description: Signed-in owner who creates dashboards and manages their own widgets.

vocabulary.description: Named collection of widgets with last-edited time.
Block inside a dashboard with title, type (note, counter, checklist, link list), size (small, medium, large), position and type-specific content.

capabilities.note: Email/password sign up, sign in, sign out for dashboard owners
Each member sees only their own dashboards and widgets
Create, list, view, rename, duplicate, edit, delete dashboards and widgets
Visitor for landing page, member for private dashboards
Public landing page explaining dashboards and how to start
Change widget position relative to other widgets
Show when each dashboard was last edited, updated by autosave

inScope: Public landing page explaining personal dashboards and how to start
Create a new dashboard and open it in the editor
List of my dashboards showing name and when each was last edited
Rename, duplicate and delete a dashboard
Add note, counter, checklist and link-list widgets to a dashboard
Configure each widget with a title and type settings: note plain text, counter label and number with increase/decrease, checklist items with tick and add, link titles and web addresses
Manage widgets: rename, change position relative to others, resize between small, medium and large, and remove
Editor saves every change automatically and updates last-edited time

assumptions.text: New dashboard created via Create starts empty with a default name like Untitled dashboard that can be renamed.
Duplicate creates a full copy including all widgets and their content with name like Copy of {name}.
Every dashboard and widget change saves automatically without a Save button and updates the dashboard last-edited time.
Dashboard list is ordered most-recently-edited first.
New widget defaults to medium size, title defaulting to its type name, appended after existing widgets.
Counter starts at 0, increases or decreases by 1 per click, label is editable, allows negative values with no min or max.
Checklist items can be added, ticked and unticked, edited and removed; ticked items stay visible.
Link list stores a title plus web address; selecting a link opens it in a new browser tab; only http/https addresses are accepted.
Deleting a dashboard permanently removes it and its widgets after confirm with no trash or undo; removing a widget deletes it immediately.
Dashboards and widgets are private to the member who created them; no sharing.
Visual style is playful but tidy; exact on-screen placement is up to design while relative widget order is preserved.
No limit on number of dashboards per user or widgets per dashboard.
